name: pull-request-labeler

schema.description: A GitHub Action for automatically labelling pull requests.
schema.title: Pull Request Labeler

description:
Team,

For our pull‑request labeling workflow, the following conventions apply. Any change that fixes an issue should be tagged with the **bug** label. Documentation updates that touch the project’s docs or modify the README should receive the **documentation** label, covering the keywords “docs” and “readme update.” New functionality is marked with **feature** when it either touches the frontend/UI (any of “frontend” or “ui”), satisfies all of the “api” and “v2” criteria together, or is described as an “enhancement.” Performance‑related work that addresses slowness or optimization opportunities should be labeled **performance**, matching any of the terms “slow” or “optimize.” Finally, routine maintenance tasks are categorized under the **chore** label, using the value “maintenance.”
